scope: Five-level n-of-1 field protocol architecture. Progression is governed by repeatability and observed tolerance, not by completion alone.
evidence_boundary: Expected adaptations are hypotheses to monitor in this subject. The protocol does not establish causal mechanisms, permanence, clinical efficacy, or population-level outcomes.

governor.purpose: Keep the planned dose aligned with current repeatable capacity.
governor.repeatable_unit: A session or block that can be completed with comparable performance and without unresolved adverse signs before the next planned exposure.
governor.intended_challenge: Specify the one primary stressor being progressed; hold other stressors as stable as practical.
progression_criteria: planned work completed without red-flag symptoms
session response remains within the subject's observed range
repeatability is demonstrated across more than one comparable exposure
the next dose changes one primary variable at a time
hold_or_regress_criteria: unresolved pain, dizziness, chest symptoms, heat illness signs, or other red flags
recovery observations remain materially outside the subject's usual range
multiple stressors changed together so the signal cannot be interpreted
governor.stop_rule: Stop the session and seek appropriate professional care for acute or concerning symptoms. TrailGenic data is not a medical clearance system.
governor.evidence_boundary: The Governor is an operational dosing heuristic, not a validated physiological subsystem, readiness score, diagnosis, or treatment rule.

protocols.purpose: Establish a repeatable low-intensity movement and recovery baseline through consistent walking.
protocols.progression_gate: Multiple comparable sessions are repeatable without red-flag symptoms and the baseline is sufficiently stable to interpret a longer dose.

protocols.purpose: Extend duration and terrain demand while preserving interpretability and repeatability.
protocols.progression_gate: Comparable two-to-three-hour exposures are repeatable and one-variable progression remains interpretable.

protocols.purpose: Observe longitudinal response to extended endurance and altitude exposure under bounded field conditions.
protocols.progression_gate: Repeated long-duration sessions remain interpretable and repeatable without relying on a single favorable metric.

protocols.purpose: Test whether observed economy and tolerance remain repeatable across longer and varied field exposures.
protocols.progression_gate: The pattern is reproduced across comparable exposures and adverse or ambiguous signals have been resolved before stacking stressors.

protocols.purpose: Operate a longitudinal field system that adjusts endurance dose using current evidence, context, and demonstrated repeatability.
protocols.progression_gate: No terminal state is asserted; the system continues to measure, compare, qualify, and revise.
